scales.focus: One nearby venue, explicit type, a named spatial anchor, radius and opening time.
One existing-visit edit, preservation, zero stay, invalid target and takeaway intent.
Multiple new visits, independent scopes, walk cap and total-time budget.
Different activity areas and time windows, dated versus undated deadlines.
Open outing request with soft themes, incomplete information and unsupported hard conditions.

multiturn_behaviours: Explicitly set, replace and clear a walk cap without treating qualitative less-walking wishes as clear.
Set takeaway true, set false and clear the preference in separately covered add and replacement scenarios.
Continue a Pending question, cancel it and confirm a later proposal without leaking unconfirmed memory.
Replace and reorder a visit, then edit its new position while keeping constraints attached to visit identity.
Preserve one place while changing its stay; retain future-only exclusions without removing existing stops.
freeze_requirements: Write new utterances rather than paraphrasing the reviewed development failures.
Fix initial state, events, catalogue facts, candidate choices and expected structured annotations before prediction collection.
Review each exact structured annotation independently and retain turn-level review evidence.
Record immutable fixture and prompt hashes, scorer/code versions and a separately authorized call cap.
Do not tune prompts using holdout predictions; if used for tuning, relabel the set as development data.
current_limit: No held-out gold labels or model results exist in this design. Counts are planned coverage, not completed validation.
